description: Detects HTTP response header construction from user input vulnerable to CRLF injection. Use when writing code that sets HTTP response headers using values from user input, request parameters, or external data. Also invoke when constructing email headers, Content-Disposition filenames, or Location headers from caller-controlled strings.
